label: ACCEPT
reason: Every *.exception.ts class in packages/core/errors/exceptions extends RuntimeException (circular-dependency, unknown-module, route-conflict); the only non-member is RuntimeException itself (the definition, one_off), and the same base is used by microservices/websockets errors. Nothing in .oxlintrc.json or tsconfig catches a new exception extending bare Error, and a team-chosen base class is worth flagging.
